systems.platform: a digital platform set up by the Algerian Space Agency (ASAL) to support the addressing operation
systems.owner: Ministère de l'Intérieur, des Collectivités locales et de l'Aménagement du territoire, through the Commission nationale d'adressage, with ASAL
systems.tiers: launched in the communes of Ouargla wilaya on 15 June 2025 after the pilot in Oran wilaya (311,000 addresses); to be extended gradually to all wilayas

note: Launch of the addressing operation in Ouargla's communes and four days of training. An application; the article does not say that commune offices are connected or that their staff work in the platform from their own offices.
